sections.title: In brief
sections.text: The first part introduces a rule-based account of changing entire design languages.

sections.title: Question or aim
sections.text: How can stylistic relationships and innovation be stated through transformations?

sections.title: Approach described
sections.text: It sketches a formal model and compares the approach with traditional, informal accounts of design change.

sections.text: The proposed model is intended both to relate historical styles and to construct new styles from known ones. Detailed formal development belongs to Part 2.
